title: Naturally Flaky Australian Chickpeas Flatbread
description: A tangy and flaky flatbread featuring chickpeas, perfect for a date night, served on a talavera plate. This raw-friendly dish is a unique Australian twist on traditional flatbreads.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, and water to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Fold the dough in half several times until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the chickpeas over the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds and paprika over the chickpeas.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the chickpeas to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on a talavera plate and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
